seo.title: Privacy policy
seo.seo_title: Nexora privacy policy for the website
seo.seo_description: Officer, information collected, purposes, disclosures, retention, rights, cookies, incidents. Draft template, to be completed and reviewed before publication.

blocks.role: Gabarit juridique en brouillon : rubriques en place, informations à compléter.

translation.headline: Privacy policy.
translation.subheadline: Draft template structured along the headings expected in Quebec; every Nexora-specific item remains to be provided by the founder.

translation.title: The privacy officer.
translation.body: Title and contact details of the person responsible for the protection of personal information, published on the site [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. By default this is the person with the highest authority in the business; designating someone else is done in writing [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

items.title: Contact form.
items.text: Name, email, company, need, envisaged deployment mode, message. Exact list [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]

items.title: Customer account.
items.text: If a customer area opens: sign-up and billing information [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]

items.title: Payment.
items.text: Handled by a payment provider [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. State what Nexora keeps or not [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER]

items.title: Technical logs.
items.text: IP address, date, pages viewed, for security and proper operation. Duration [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]

items.title: Audience measurement.
items.text: Chosen tool and configuration (with or without cookies) [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]

items.title: Customers' system data.
items.text: Handled under the agreement with the customer; it falls outside this policy.

translation.title: Why we use it.
translation.body: To answer your request, provide and bill the service, keep the site secure, improve its content. Commercial messages are sent only with consent, with no pre-ticked box, and each one allows unsubscribing. Answering a request and marketing sign-up are two separate things. Exact purposes [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

translation.title: Who we share it with.
translation.body: Providers in the service chain (site hosting, email, payment, audience measurement), each with its role and location [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. For any disclosure of information outside Quebec, a prior assessment and a written agreement are required [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER]. Nexora does not sell personal information [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: How long we keep it.
translation.body: Retention period for each category, then destruction or anonymization [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. Retention and destruction rules are part of the governance policies that the law requires to be published [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

translation.title: Your rights.
translation.body: Access your information, have it corrected, withdraw your consent, unsubscribe, obtain your information in a structured, commonly used technological format where the law provides, and file a complaint with the business and then with the Commission d'accès à l'information. How to proceed and the request address [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. Time limits [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

translation.title: Cookies and tracking technologies.
translation.body: List of the cookies and technologies used, their purpose, and how to refuse them. Any technology that can identify, locate or profile a person requires prior information and an opt-in choice. Chosen configuration (essential only, or others) [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: In case of an incident.
translation.body: Description of the procedure: assessing the risk of harm, notifying the Commission d'accès à l'information and the people concerned when the risk is serious, keeping an incident register [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: Changes and date.
translation.body: Date of the last update and how you are informed of a material change [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

blocks.role: Liste de ce que le fondateur doit compléter ou faire valider avant toute publication.

translation.title: To do before publishing.
translation.body: This page is a template. It stays a draft, unpublished and not indexed, until the following points are settled.

items.title: Fill in the markers.
items.text: Every [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER] must be replaced with the real information; no value is invented.

items.title: Have a lawyer review it.
items.text: The text must be reviewed by a Quebec lawyer [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

items.title: Approve, then publish.
items.text: Only after these two points, remove the draft status and the indexing ban.
